process_observations.observation: An object-model step writing twelve CustomFields cites no field-creation skill, and admin/object-creation-and-design's own description says 'NOT for designing the fields on the object - use admin/custom-field-creation'.

Status__c is required true, and permissions for required fields cannot be retrieved or deployed (api_meta.txt:95020-95021), so M1-S02's 'every custom field readable and editable' covers eleven fields, not twelve — a fieldPermissions entry for Status__c would fail that deploy.

externalSharingModel is a second OWD that defaults on in an Experience Cloud org, and nothing in the plan, the clarifications or D12 names it; the element was left out rather than guessed and is flagged in deploy-order.md section 5.

inputs.custom_object.optional_feature_trio states the all-or-none rule for enableBulkApi/enableSharing/enableStreamingApi but not whether the three are true or absent; both shapes clear every declared checker, and true was written following the only fenced example the cited skills carry.
All three declared checkers exited 0 on the first pass with no repair loop, because the plan had already named each checker's full exit-1 set in the step inputs after verifier warning W2.
The step is built and its molecular tests have not been run by this agent.
